outline:
IoT通訊原理介紹，IoT技術標準與架構，IoT市場與應用趨勢，IoT資訊系統與管理，IoT系統發展與應用，IoT資訊安全與隱私，其他。
Introduction of wired and wireless Communication, Infrastructure of IoT, Protocols and standards of IoT, IoT markets and application trends, informative management system of IoT, IOT system development and applications,IoT informational security and privacy, others.
